name: Access To God
overview: The sample verses from Exodus and Leviticus reveal that access to God was once highly restricted, as seen when only Moses was permitted to approach the LORD (Exodus 24:2). Yet, God’s presence is marked by His merciful and gracious nature, as He proclaimed His name and attributes to Moses on Mount Sinai (Exodus 34:4-7). The use of the censer and incense brought within the veil (Leviticus 16:12) typifies the sacred approach to God, pointing forward to the privilege believers now have to come near through Christ and the Holy Spirit. Thus, Scripture teaches that access to God is both a solemn privilege and a gracious gift, granted to those reconciled to Him and exemplified in the Old Testament worship practices.
